status: Leo, 2026-11-19: "cmux sans/manaflow sans". The family is cmux Sans, cmux Serif (Text and Display) and cmux Mono; its signature axis WEFT is named Selvedge. Bases and table: hq docs/research/2026-11-19-our-own-type-family.md (hq#13922): the Source superfamily on one table. The line box is Quillet's (960 / -240), not the doc's 980 / -270, so a swap between the two families moves no line; see the PR.
